<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/gift-lists/{postId}/participants"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starter only. `userIds` are everyone besides the starter, each a
member of the family. Removed participants lose their wishlist. New
participants get a `gift_list_invite` notification. After the draw a
change needs `confirmRedraw: true` (`409` otherwise) and then redraws
from scratch, notifying every participant — or clears the draw when it
no longer qualifies (fewer than 3 people, impossible exclusions).
